text: A cute little floating island with a bunny-like creature and a tomato patch. Day 2, 10 coins, Lv1. A hint says 'Tap the ripe crop'. I'll tap the tomatoes.
Hmm, my tap opened a panel for 'Momo' (Free time, Assign) instead of harvesting. The bunny walked behind the crop so I probably hit it. Trying to tap lower on the tomatoes.
Harvested! Coins 10->14, XP 3/90. Now 'Tap the farm to sow' and a bar with Sow/Water/Harvest appeared, Sow is highlighted. Tapping Sow.
Sowed (+1 EXP). Days are only 30 seconds - already night! 'Tap again to water' - Water button glowing. Tapping it.
Watered. Harvest shows '2s left'. Now 'Tap a Momo' - so the bunny is a Momo. Tapping it.
Momo selected. Tomatoes ripe again already. Hint: tap the pencil to pick tiles this Momo looks after. So Momo is a worker I can assign. Tapping the pencil.
Tile picking mode, 0/4 tiles. I'll tap the farm plot so Momo looks after it.

Momo now 'Working at Farm', 1/4 tiles. Coins 18, +8/min. Tip: empty tiles can build farm/mine/lumberyard/lab. An empty tile on the left is highlighted. Tapping Got it, then I want to build on that empty tile.
Momo is farming by itself now (6 jobs, coins 22, +12/min). Mailbox has a red dot and there's an envelope bubble over Momo. First I'll confirm tile selection with the check mark.
Confirmed. Momo earns +$4 per harvest, farm skill went up to 1. Coins 30, +20/min. Nice idle feel. Now checking the Mailbox with the red dot.
A sweet letter from Momo proposing 'Field expansion' research. Charming! Tapping 'Let's research it'.
Now 'On the research list'. Coins 46, +32/min. Let me open Research to see it.
Research tree with tabs Farm/Lumber/Mine/Smelting/Power/Games... Field expansion costs 3 flasks + $20, 20s. Button says 'Build a research lab' - I need a lab to make flasks. Tapping that button.
'Build a research lab' did nothing - it's just a greyed hint, not a button. I wish it would take me to building one. Closing research and tapping an empty grass tile to build.
Build menu: Farm $10, Mine (Lv3), Lumberyard (Lv2), Research lab (Lv2), Special 0/1. I'm Lv1 74/90 so lab is close. For now build a second Farm for $10 - I have 70.
A second farm is being built on the left tile (2 sec). Mailbox still has a red dot - another letter? Opening it.
Level 2! New letter 'Maybe we could water less often' and a tip: I can buy sea tiles next to the island for $25 to expand. Lots going on at once. Reading the letter first.
Watering efficiency proposal. Adding to research list, then closing. Now that I'm Lv2 I want to build the research lab on the empty bottom-right grass tile.
Build menu now: Research lab $40, Lumberyard $80. I have 104. Building the Research lab so I can do Momo's proposals.
Lab under construction. It says 'Research lab 0/1' - probably needs a worker, and I only have one Momo who's busy farming. Let me look at Hire.
Lab is built - pretty blue-roofed house. Hire Momo costs $60, I have 84. Hiring a second Momo to run the lab.
Hired 'Mochi' (cute name!). Coins 28. A flask counter '1' appeared top-left and the lab shows +1 flask. I'll give Mochi the lab tile with the pencil.
Mochi given the lab tile (marked 1). Flasks now 2. Oddly Mochi's status says 'the next crop is ripening' though I gave it the lab... Confirming, then going to Research once I have 3 flasks.
Level 3! 3 flasks, Mochi 'Working at Research lab'. 'Start research' is available for Field expansion. Starting it!
Researching, 19s. Satisfying! Mailbox red dot again - reading it while research runs.

Third letter: Bigger harvests (compost). Each letter maps to a node in the research tree - nice way to introduce research. Adding it. Mochi's card says 'Since the change: 0 -> 4 jobs a day' - feedback on my assignment, neat.
Coins 100, 4 flasks. Research has a red dot - Field expansion probably finished. Opening it.
Field expansion done (Lv1/5). Watering efficiency and Bigger harvests are now unlocked. I have 5 flasks - Watering efficiency costs exactly 5. Selecting it.
Started Watering efficiency (1m30s). Now I'm Lv3 so Mine should be open. There's still one empty grass tile at the bottom of the island. Closing research and tapping it.
Mine needs $120 + Wood 10 (wood in red, I have none). So Lumberyard first ($80). I have 156, +136/min - income is snowballing nicely. Building a Lumberyard on this last tile.
Lumberyard going up. Island is full now (4 tiles). It'll need a worker too, so checking Hire price.
Lumberyard is done and someone is already chopping (+2 wood, +$6). Wood counter appeared top-left. Hire is now $100 (was 60). Hiring a third Momo since I have 130.
New Momo 'Pomu' standing on the lumberyard. This time I'll try the 'Assign' button instead of the pencil, to see what it does.
Assign says 'Tap a building for this Momo'. Tapping the lumberyard (the axe/log tile at the bottom), avoiding Pomu's body.
Hmm, 'Another Momo works here' - so someone already took the lumberyard. Confusing: who? Wood is 4. Let me check Status to see who's doing what.

Status screen gives me a real goal: grow Village into a City - Land 4/9, Momo 3/3 done, Research levels 1/3, Value $470/$1.5K. Great, now I know what to aim for. Land is the next thing: buying the $25 sea tile. Pomu still has 'Free time'.
Pomu's panel covers most of the sea tile and its $25 price tag. Tapping the visible part of the dashed sea tile.

Bought land - a new grassy tile rose from the sea (+15 EXP), next one costs $35. Research has a red dot - Watering efficiency probably done. Opening Research to queue the next one (City needs 3 research levels).
Watering efficiency Lv1 done. 12 flasks, $205. Bigger harvests (8 flasks) is ready - selecting and starting it.
Bigger harvests started. Now I have 10 wood - enough for a Mine. Tapping the new land tile to build one.
Mine is affordable now ($120 + 10 wood; I have 213 and 14 wood). Building it!
Level 4! Mine under construction (7 sec). Reading the new letter meanwhile.

This letter is from Mochi now - Tree nursery for the lumber line. Mine is built, a cute hill with a door, and a Momo already digs there (Mine 1/1) - Momos seem to pick up free buildings on their own. Adding the proposal, then buying the next land tile ($35).
Got 1 stone already. Mine now says 0/1 though, and two Momos are standing idle on the farm. There's a 'Dig 4 sec' button - I'll dig by hand to try it.
Digging (5s left), stone 2. Coins 233, +170/min. Now buying the next land tile ($35) - the dashed square at bottom-left.
Second land tile bought (+10 EXP). The island is growing into an L shape, looks lovely. I'll put a cheap Farm on it.
Build menu up. Curious about the gold star 'Special 0/1' - peeking at it before deciding.
Specials are landmarks: Clock Tower (Lv5), School ($400, 30 wood, 20 stone), Momo Monument (Lv6). Nice long-term goals! Can't afford yet. Going back and building a Farm.
Third farm built on the new land. Hire now $155 (60 -> 100 -> 155, rising). I have 372 - hiring a 4th Momo for the extra buildings.
Hired 'Mugi'. Assigning Mugi to the new bottom farm.
Mugi is 'On the way: Farm'. Research dot again - quickly queuing the next research before time runs out.
Bigger harvests done - that's 3 research levels, which the City goal wanted. Three new nodes lit up. Picking Greenhouse.

City progress: Momo 4/3 done, Research 3/3 done, Value $1.2K/$1.5K, Land 6/9 is the remaining gap. $300/min now. If I had more time I'd buy 3 more land tiles and become a City. Really want to keep going.
